---
title: "Protein extract"
description: "Extract selected protein sequences from a reference FASTA and report matched/unmatched identifiers."
---

## Input

Upload a reference protein **FASTA** file and provide protein IDs either by pasting them line-by-line or by uploading a `.txt`, `.csv`, or `.tsv` list.

## Workflow

1. Upload the reference FASTA.
2. Enter or upload the target protein IDs.
3. Click **Extract Proteins**.
4. Review **Matched Sequences**, **Sequence Table**, **FASTA Viewer**, and **Unmatched IDs**.
5. Download the complete result package as a ZIP archive.

## Quality checks

Protein extraction is exact only when the ID syntax in the target list matches the FASTA headers. If many expected proteins are reported as unmatched, inspect whether the FASTA uses transcript suffixes, database prefixes, version suffixes, or pipe-delimited headers.

::: {.callout-tip}
Keep the unmatched-ID list. It is useful for diagnosing annotation-version differences and prevents silent loss of candidates before downstream structure or enrichment analysis.
:::
